besluite.fout: 'in dieselfde plek' copies English 'in the same place'; Afrikaans says 'op dieselfde plek'.
besluite.rede: The fixed Afrikaans expression is 'op dieselfde plek', and both versions still say the springbok lives where the grass lives, so the meaning has not moved.

besluite.fout: 'vol gras en baie min bome' can be read as 'full of very few trees'.
besluite.rede: With 'met', 'few trees' clearly attaches to the habitat and not to 'vol'; it is still a habitat with lots of grass and few trees.

'aan die kante' is the video's own wording and reads fine, and 'op die walle' changes the place, because reeds grow at the water's edge and not only up on the banks, which also matches the riete definition's 'langs water'.
